limitations: One paired software-emulator run; repeat adverse/noisy cases before acceptance.
An identical-APK control measures environment variation and cannot accept a new renderer.
HWUI quantiles cover its recent CSV ring; actual presentation polling covers the complete motion.
PSS trend is a short bounded soak, not proof of indefinite memory stability.
Separate interaction/upgrade/save smoke and visual review are required before the phase gate.
No fixed physical-device FPS or isolated hardware GPU utilization claimed.

limits: Complete matched A-I on day25 war fixture; baseline/candidate start identically. V7 primary war fixture was day1, so cross-candidate war/simulation results are not a controlled bounds-only comparison.
Zoom-in P95+22.90%, continuousLOD P99+32.24%, terrain P99+22.13%, active simulation P95+11.49%/P99+44.77%, extended startP99+29.47% and endP95+15.20%. All exact failing ratios retained.
Extended peakPSS464496->446096KiB is within32MiB; this short bounded soak does not establish indefinite memory stability or explain the adverse monthly endpoint (+63721KiB).
Cold/upgrade/input/order/march/save-restart/monthly/stagedLOD/API functionality and graphics passed. No success inferred over the failing primary tails.
Isolated CPU recording wins and first dev7 zoom-out gains are not a complete camera acceptance or physical handset proof.
Preserve prototype/evidence, restore default accepted renderer; no later gameplay stage, main merge or2.3 release.
